title: COSE/wscbor: Handle indefinite tstr/bstr encodings
description:
This change adds support for the `wscbor` decoder to handle indefinite-length encodings for byte strings and text strings. This improves robustness to non-[Deterministically Encoded CBOR](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8949#section-4.2), which is allowed by CBOR itself but prohibited by the COSE specification.

This change also makes the `wscbor` component more ABI stable by hiding some internal chunk state in a private struct.
